component.name: Signal Chain
component.summary: Real-time patch editor and preset library manager for guitar and bass multi-effects

description.p: Signal Chain is a cross-platform patch editor and preset manager designed for guitar and bass multi-effects processors, including Zoom MS Plus pedals (MS-50G+, MS-60B+, MS-70CDR+, MS-200+) and Line 6 Bass Pod Pro rack units.

ul.li: Real-time bidirectional parameter editing and hardware footswitch synchronization.
Intuitive drag-and-drop pedalboard signal chain reordering, effect insertion, and removal.
Comprehensive patch library management with local preset storage, import, and export.
Hardware patch memory bank browsing and one-click slot management.
Direct low-latency ALSA MIDI transport support on Linux.

description.p: Initial release of Signal Chain Flutter edition for Linux.
